# Codex-style Worktree (dsh-codex-style-worktree)
**English** | 简体中文
> A "work like Codex" placement choice for DSH sessions: on the new-session hero row, pick **Local**
or **New local worktree** (the default) next to the workspace chip; after you send the first messag
e the plugin creates a detached checkout and switches **that session's** cwd into it. No new Workspa
ce, no naming, no branch from the plugin (Git owns branch naming at commit time).
- Version: `0.5.1` (2026-10-20; package / plugin id / loader row name: `dsh-codex-style-worktree`; p

rofile-patch insert row id: `codex-worktree`)
- API namespace: `/api/dsh-codex-style-worktree`, RPC
method prefix `dsh-codex-style-worktree/`; sidecar: `$DSH_HOME/dsh-codex-style-worktree/state.json`;

disable marker: `.dsh-codex-style-worktree-off`
- GitHub: <https://github.com/wplct/dsh-codex-style

-worktree>
- Requirements: DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2`, Node.js `>= 22.19.0`, `git` on PATH
- Li

- Requirements: DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2`, Node.js `>= 22.19.0`, `git` on PATH
- License: MIT
## What changed in 0.4.0 (vs 0.3.0)
| Capability | 0.3.0 | 0.4.0 |
| Cleanup guard | Cleanup deletes directly | Refused when the checkout is **another** active session
's current cwd (`worktree-in-use`); cleaning your own session's checkout first moves its cwd back to

the workspace; `force` overrides after confirmation |
| Snapshot before delete | Only autoPrune kep
t a ref for detached commits | Every delete path: when the checkout is detached and `HEAD ≠ baseComm
it`, write `refs/dsh-codex-style-worktree/<timestamp+session suffix>` and record it in the sidecar |
| Snapshot restore | Manual `git branch` only | `/wt-snapshots`, `/wt-restore <ref>`, and a "recove

rable snapshots" list in the settings page |
| Archive cleanup | Checkouts always kept after a sessi
on ends | Optional `cleanupOnArchive` (default off): a lazy sweep removes clean, unused checkouts af

ter archive |
| RPC | 6 endpoints | 7 (adds `restore`); the `list` response gains per-repository `sn

apshots` |
| Sidecar | v2 | v3 (adds a `snapshots` map; v1/v2 are migrated in memory on read, no dat

|
| Sidecar | v2 | v3 (adds a `snapshots` map; v1/v2 are migrated in memory on read, no data loss) |
### What changed in 0.3.0 (vs 0.2.x) — history
| Capability | 0.2.x | 0.3.0 |
| When the worktree is created | Automatically for every new session (no choice); a "New Worktree" b
utton could also create one on demand | You choose a placement on the hero row; the worktree is crea

ted **after the first message** (first-turn `agent/pre-step`) |
| Selector location | A dock button
above the composer | The hero workspace row: a pill between `📁 workspace ▼` and `standard mode ▼` |
| Remembered choice | None | **Per workspace**, persisted in the sidecar (`placements`), restart-saf

e |
| Workspace | The old button called `workspaces.create`, cluttering the sidebar | **Never create

s a Workspace**; only the session cwd changes |
| Progress feedback | None | Inline three-step progr

ess card above the composer (projection-driven, minimum 1 s) |
| Sidebar | No marker | Managed sessi

ons show a **read-only** worktree icon (tooltip = checkout path) |
| Settings page | Read-only confi
g | **Editable form**; save writes the active profile patch and applies live (volatile, no restart)

|
| State sync | Some RPC reads | Everything is event/projection-driven, **zero polling** |
| RPC |
Included `create`, etc. | `status/list/clean/prune/placement/settings`, no `create`/`cancel` |
## 1. What it does
1. On the new-session hero row (the blank state without a session id) the workspace row shows a plac

ement pill: **New local worktree** (default) or **Local**;
2. the choice is written back to the host
immediately and persisted **per workspace path** in the sidecar; later sessions in that workspace i

nherit it, across restarts;
3. you send the first message → the Session's first turn starts with `ag
ent/pre-step` (before the model's first step) → the host decides by that workspace's placement wheth

er to create a checkout;
4. with "New local worktree": a **detached HEAD** checkout is created at `<
repo>/.agents/worktrees/wt-<timestamp>` and **this session's** working directory is switched to it;

the session stays attached to its original Workspace;
5. creation progress is pushed through the `co
dexWorktree` session projection and rendered as an inline progress card above the composer (`Prepare
workspace → Check out files → Set up environment`); when done the card fades and the header chip pl

us the sidebar marker appear;
[该节后续省略]
## 8. Compatibility, limitations and risks
- **DSH versions**: `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2`; depends on the base bundle's `sessionProjections`,
`settings` and `configEditor` — missing ones degrade gracefully: no projections → sidebar marker / p

rogress card unavailable; no settings → read-only config;
- **Node.js >= 22.19.0** (the client uses

React 18+ `useSyncExternalStore`);
- **Creation happens only on the first step of a Session's first
turn** and only for top-level Sessions whose recorded creation source is `startup`; resume / clear /
compaction / subagents / taskboard sessions / matching presets / disable marker / `enabled: false`
/ existing record / placement=local never create one. A blank Session that is opened and never used
creates nothing, so a placement choice made in it is read at send time and cannot lag one Session be
o naming, no branch** (detached by default); `mode: branch` is opt-in; the plugin never merges, push

es or deletes user branches;
- **Non-Git workspaces**: the selector is hidden and nothing is created

;
- **Read-only sandbox / workspace-write boundary / no commit / limit**: structured errors that nev

er block the session;
- concurrent creation in one repository is serialized by `createKeyedMutex`; a
ny exception inside the `agent/pre-step` listener is swallowed and warned about, so the plugin can n

ever prevent a session from starting or block the first message;
- projection events enter the sessi
on log (~4 per new session), the cost of zero polling; an ephemeral channel could replace them later

(out of scope for this release);
- **known limitation**: cleaning a non-live session's checkout fro
m the settings page leaves its sidebar marker until that session's next consistency repair (reopenin

g the session or its first step; see 2.4);
[该节后续省略]
